items.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996
items.q: He has also performed with the great big bands of Duke Ellington and Lionel Hampton

ctx.x: The current Count Basie Orchestra is under the able leadership of trombonist Grover Mitchell. Grover first joined the Basie band in November of 1962 and led the trombone section for important years during the 60s and 70s. He has also performed with the great big bands of Duke Ellington and Lionel Hampton, and appears on many recordings with all of these ensembles. In Basie’s later years, Grover became an important companion and confidante for the Count.
As he himself puts it, “I grew into this job.”
